top_reviews.text: I like the red plaid and the fit was perfect. And was shipped right away.

top_reviews.title: Glad to find these on Amazon as they are hard to find in stores!
top_reviews.text:
I've been wearing this style of sneaker (Skechers D'Lites) for over a decade now although I prefer the ones without laces. They tend to last me about one year before I need a new pair - even though they still look good, the support eventually fails and my feet/knees start to get sore.

Amazon has the best price for these shoes and I'm so glad to find this particular style and NOT the ones with memory foam. There's a huge difference and although it wouldn't seem that way, the ones with memory foam don't support my feet at all.

I just replaced the laces with the jogger elastic kind and have been extremely pleased. I also purchased a Navy pair.

top_reviews.title: Awesome sneaks.
top_reviews.text: I love these sneakers. I where them for work and trust me I am on my feet all day and I put a lot of miles on these shoes. They are very comfy and supportive. I get sore heals and I have found that these prevent that the best. They are also pretty slip resistant - I also work on wet floors. They hold up pretty well too considering how hard on them I am. I usually go through 2 pairs a year but keep in mind that's 50 hours a week of non stop abuse that they take. I usually spray them with a simple sneaker water proofer and my feet never get wet even stomping through the snow on my way to and from work. They are well worth the money. I know my mom also a pair that she's been wearing for years. So considering that I have bought approximately 15 pairs of these sneakers - I would say that I highly reccomend them. The only way they could get any better is if the company would throw me a free pair considering the amount that I have purchased - haha...

top_reviews.title: Great shoes
top_reviews.text: My chiropractor wears Sketchers so wanted to try them for myself. I do not like heavy shoes & these D'Lites are wonderful!I bought my first pair locally & very happy with the true to size fit & comfort. Then purchased 2 more of different colors at great savings from Amazon. I had even tried New Balance but returned several before trying these!

dialogue.user:
The Corkys Kayak slip-ons sound really promising! They're called cute in the reviews, they're great for outdoor use, and at $26.88 they're well within my budget. And with a 4.6 rating, that's above my 3.0 minimum too. I think these are exactly what I'm looking for!

Thanks for your help, I'll take the Corkys Women's Kayak Slip On Boat Sneakers!
